claims.text: Aglahad was a descendant of Galador, the first Prince of Dol Amroth; through Galador's mother Mithrellas, Aglahad had some Elven blood.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, Christopher Tolkien (ed.), Unfinished Tales, "The History of Galadriel and Celeborn"

claims.text: Aglahad ruled Dol Amroth around the time of Steward Turgon. During Aglahad's reign as Prince, Gondor had to abandon much of Ithilien.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix B, "The Third Age"

claims.text: After his death, his son Angelimir became the twentieth Prince.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, Christopher Tolkien (ed.), The Peoples of Middle-earth, "VII. The Heirs of Elendil", The House of Dol Amroth, p. 223
